bullet.name: a fact too long to be one fact
bullet.body: This fact runs on and on, well past anything a single sentence-sized memory should hold, because it tries to explain the whole history of the daemon, why it is shared, which sockets it binds, where its token lives, how the release and dev builds split their files, and what to do when a protocol bump lands while sessions are open.
